应用限制
守护策略
家长控制
如何请求用户授权以获取健康使用设备的管理权限？
如何取消用户已授予的授权？
如何拉起应用选择页让用户勾选需要管理的应用？
如何添加守护策略来限制应用使用时间？
如何修改、查询或删除已有的守护策略？
如何启动和停止守护策略？
如何设置应用访问限制来立即禁止或允许应用？
如何解除应用访问限制？

如何申请受限ACL权限？
当你需要开发一款家长控制或时间管理类应用时，应使用Screen Time Guard Kit
它提供了完整的应用使用时间管控方案，从用户授权、应用选择到策略管理和访问限制，覆盖了健康使用设备的全部流程
当你需要对特定应用设置使用时间限制（如限制儿童使用游戏应用的时间）时，可以通过守护策略的三种类型灵活配置
当你需要立即禁止或允许某个应用的访问时，可以使用应用访问限制能力实现即时生效的管控
接入家长管控功能并限制孩子使用指定应用的时长 / Integrate parental controls to limit how long selected apps can be used
实现每日应用使用时长配额并在超时后自动禁用 / Implement daily app time quotas and automatically block apps after the limit
拉起受管控应用选择器让用户挑选要限制的应用 / Launch the managed app picker so users can choose which apps to restrict
创建按天重复生效的屏幕使用守护计划 / Create a recurring daily screen-time guard schedule
暂停和恢复某个应用的使用限制策略 / Pause and resume a usage restriction policy for a specific app
立即封禁某些应用并在需要时一键解禁 / Instantly block certain apps and unblock them when needed
查询当前生效的应用管控规则和剩余可用时长 / Query active app control rules and remaining allowed time
更新已有的守护策略时段、目标应用和限制时长 / Update an existing guard policy's time window, target apps, and duration
删除不再需要的屏幕时间限制规则 / Remove screen-time restriction rules that are no longer needed
获取健康使用设备授权并管理用户授予的管理权限 / Obtain Device Usage management authorization and manage granted permissions
在达到使用上限时触发应用不可访问状态 / Make apps inaccessible once the usage limit is reached
按工作日和周末分别配置不同的应用使用限制 / Configure different app usage limits for weekdays and weekends
do_not_use_when: 需求是扫码、识别或生成条形码和二维码，并处理暗光、模糊、曲面码等复杂识别场景；应改用 scan-kit / The task is to scan, recognize, or generate barcodes and QR codes, including difficult cases like low light, blur, or curved codes; use scan-kit instead
preconditions: 应用已完成Screen Time Guard Kit所需签名配置并获批受限ACL权限 / The app has completed the required signing configuration for Screen Time Guard Kit and obtained the restricted ACL permission
运行环境为中国大陆主空间的Phone或Tablet设备，且不是隐私空间、子空间或分身应用 / The runtime environment is a Phone or Tablet in mainland China main space, and not privacy space, subspace, or a cloned app
目标设备和当前HarmonyOS版本已提供健康使用设备服务相关能力 / The target device and current HarmonyOS version provide the Health Device Usage service capabilities
执行策略管理或访问限制前，用户已完成相应授权并且授权状态有效 / Before policy management or access restriction, the user has granted the required authorization and the authorization remains valid
inputs: 用户授权状态或授权请求参数 / user authorization status or authorization request parameters
受管控应用列表或应用选择结果 / managed app list or app selection result
守护策略配置 / guard policy configuration
策略标识、启停动作或访问限制参数 / policy identifier, start-stop action, or access restriction parameters

postconditions.statement: 代码中接入了健康使用设备服务相关API调用，用于授权、应用选择、策略管理或访问限制中的至少一种能力 / The code integrates Health Device Usage service API calls for at least one of authorization, app selection, policy management, or access restriction
postconditions.judge_prompt: Does the edit set clearly add or modify code that calls Screen Time Guard Kit related APIs for authorization, app selection, guard policy management, or app access restriction?

postconditions.statement: 若涉及新增或变更守护策略，代码中明确体现了策略类型或生效参数（如起止时间、总时长、共享时长） / If a guard policy is added or changed, the code explicitly specifies the policy type or effective parameters (such as start-end time, total duration, or shared duration)
postconditions.judge_prompt: If the task adds or updates a guard policy, do the edits explicitly define the policy type or its effective timing parameters such as start/end time, total duration, or shared duration?

postconditions.statement: 若涉及受限能力接入，工程配置或调用流程中体现了前置校验，如授权状态检查、能力可用性判断或相关配置补充 / If restricted capability integration is involved, the project configuration or call flow includes prerequisite checks such as authorization state verification, capability availability checks, or related configuration updates
postconditions.judge_prompt: Do the edits show prerequisite handling for this restricted kit, such as checking authorization status, verifying capability availability, or adding required project configuration?
